en: {fb:0481}{n}{e0:0B12}{spk:0080}{n}Angel... I'm in the middle of training, so I can't talk right now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:0C12}{spk:0080}{n}I'm sorry, but could you come back another time?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:0D12}{spk:0080}{n}Excuse me.{n}{fd:E78379830080}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0581}{n}{e0:0E12}{spk:0080}{n}Oh, Angel... I'm sorry, but I want to concentrate on my training.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:0F12}{spk:0080}{n}I imagine you came to talk, but please, some other time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:1012}{spk:0080}{n}I'm sorry. Excuse me.{n}{fd:E78379830080}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0681}{n}{e0:1112}{spk:0080}{n}Please don't appear at a time like this, Angel. I'm sorry, but I'd rather not be spoken to while I'm training...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:1212}{spk:0080}{n}I'm sorry.{n}{fd:E78379830080}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What's the matter, Juliana?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What is it, Juliana?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{e0:2201}{spk:0080}{n}The fairy told me an angel would come if called, but I couldn't believe it...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2301}{spk:0080}{n}So I had her call you, to see whether you would really come.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2401}{spk:0080}{n}I'm sorry for bringing you here for no better reason than that...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛It's no trouble at all.　　　　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛Do you believe me now?　　　　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛Next time, call when you need me.｝{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}For you to say that... I'm truly sorry for being so rude.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I feel I understand a little of what kind of person you are, Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Yes. I feel I understand a little of what kind of person you are, Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Please forgive my rudeness. Thank you for today.{n}{fd:0D8000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I suppose so... I'm very sorry.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Still, I feel I understand you a little better now, Angel. Thank you...{n}{fd:0D8000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:2501}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh... Angel. You came.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What is it, Juliana?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2601}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, it's nothing important, but there was something I wanted to talk to you about...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛I'd be glad to keep you company.｝{n}{f7:0080}｛Is something troubling you?　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I'll listen, if you'll have me.｝{n}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}It's nothing so very important, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Then, could you spare me a little of your time?{n}{fd:0D8000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}No... it isn't that sort of thing, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm sorry you went to the trouble of coming.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Yes, thank you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Then, could you spare me a little of your time, Angel?{n}{fd:0D8000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Of course. You called me, after all.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:2801}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}But you're busy, aren't you? I'm sorry for being selfish.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛Please don't worry about that!｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I wanted to see you too.　　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I am busy, it's true, but...　｝{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}But selfishness is selfishness... I'll be careful not to cause you any trouble.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Still, thank you for coming to see me...{n}{fd:0D8000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{e5:0180}{n}It's kind of you to say so... But if I'm too selfish, I'll only be a burden to you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I'll think a little more about your position...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}I'm sorry. I was too selfish after all...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}But somehow, saying that is just like you. Thank you for coming...{n}{fd:0D8000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:1801}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh, Angel... I thought you weren't going to come anymore...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{e0:1701}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes. I wanted to give you this.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}Why, it's {name:0280}.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:1901}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I hoped it might be of some use... Will you accept it?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I'm so glad it pleases you this much...{n}{fd:0D8000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I'm just glad you accepted it...{n}{fd:0D8000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I had no idea there was such a precept... I didn't know, but still, I'm sorry.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What is it, Juliana?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What's wrong, Juliana?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{e0:1B01}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}I became your hero. But if I'm never given a single request, I don't see the point...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:1C01}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}If there are no requests, I would like to be free to see to my own affairs.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is that so? Then I may take you at your word?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Then I'll be waiting for your request, Angel...{n}{fe:0D8002800180}{n}{fd:0D8001800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}If you have nothing to ask of me, then what was the point of making me your hero, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}If this keeps up, I really will have to reconsider. Please don't forget that.{n}{fe:0D8000800180}{n}{fd:0D8002800180}{n}{fd:0D8001800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Please do. My time is precious to me.{n}{fd:0D8000800180}{n}{fe:0D8002800180}{n}{fd:0D8001800080}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:1D01}{spk:0080}{n}Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{e0:1E01}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}What do you take me for? Request after request, with no time to rest...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:1F01}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}At this rate, my body won't hold out. I am not some convenient tool for you, Angel!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2001}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Or is this simply how angels do things?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛Complaining won't help.　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I'm sorry.　　　　　　　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛Can't you try a bit harder?｝{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I see... I understand. So that is what angels are.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}I can't speak for the others, but don't expect a second time from me.{n}{fe:0D8000800180}{n}{fd:0D8002800180}{n}{fd:0D8001800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Then I'll take my rest without holding back.{n}{fd:0D8000800180}{n}{fe:0D8002800180}{n}{fe:0D8001800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Even so, you want me to take requests... Very well.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}So angels truly are that kind of being after all.{n}{fd:0D8000800080}{n}{fe:0D8002800180}{n}{fd:0D8001800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is there something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I intruding?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, not particularly. You came on some business, didn't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No. Rather than worrying about me, perhaps you should worry about yourself.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like traveling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I... can't say I find traveling much fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you getting enough rest?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes. I rest as I see fit.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}How am I feeling? Neither good nor bad...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was worried, so I came to see you.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I don't recall doing anything to make you worry...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's nice to walk outdoors, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}It is... I'd like to walk a little more leisurely, feeling the wind.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}What? You say the strangest things sometimes, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's been a while.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}So it has... You look well too, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you come across any beautiful scenery?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}But I've had little time to look around, so I don't remember it well...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did I startle you, turning up so suddenly?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, not really.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}You always turn up suddenly, Angel... I'm used to it by now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I wondered how you were doing.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, nothing has changed.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}All I think about is reaching my destination even one day sooner...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If there's anything I can do, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Thank you. But I'm fine...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I want to take care of my own affairs myself...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I'm sorry, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might have lost your way.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Pardon?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}That's a rather rude thing to say, Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we walk a little slower?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh? Do I walk that fast?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I can't help wanting to hurry, but walking slowly now and then might be nice...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}There are some lovely flowers in bloom.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh, so there are... I nearly walked right past them.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Thank you, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:AA80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does anything frighten you on your travels?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not really. I've hardly ever thought about it...{n}{wait}{clear}If worrying kept me from hurrying on, that would be worse for me now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:B480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you discovered anything new?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Anything new...? Well... I haven't paid it much attention.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:BE80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like traveling alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes... I've always been alone, after all...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a place that holds memories for you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}A place with memories... I'm sorry, but I'd rather not think about that...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:D280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is the fairy a help to you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, she's doing her best for me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:DC80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Isn't traveling hard on you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, I'm all right. Please don't worry so much.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you come across any beautiful scenery?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}But I've had little time to look around, so I don't remember it well...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8380}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If there's anything I can do, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{e5:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Thank you. But I'm fine...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I want to take care of my own affairs myself...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0680}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I'm sorry, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is that all?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope you have sweet dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I'd like to sleep soundly and have nice dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Was I that much of a bother?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, please don't worry about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I'm often awake all night anyway.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was a little worried about you.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}You're concerned about me?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Thank you, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you like staying up late?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, I don't dislike it.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}It's more that I have trouble falling asleep...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Let's do our best tomorrow too.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Yes.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Though I can't say whether I'll live up to your expectations, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Won't you come outside? The stars are beautiful.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}It's kind of you to ask, but I'll decline tonight.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}But thank you, Angel. Please ask me again.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Get a good rest, all right?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Thank you. You should rest too, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Please don't fuss over me so. I'm all right...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Was today a good day?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Can you sleep soundly in a strange bed?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}No... But it isn't so much the bed being different...{n}{wait}{clear}Oh, never mind. Please don't worry about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you make of angels existing?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Of angels...?{n}{wait}{clear}I'm not sure... You're right here in front of me, and yet...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
